purpose: Close three pre-execution audit gaps without redesigning the already-frozen statistical or biological tests: coordinate-provenance concordance, explicit data-use/terms recording, and non-independence wording for same-study Nott contact/accessibility evidence.

C3_COORDINATE_PROVENANCE_CONCORDANCE.requirement: For each Nott/FILER ATAC track, independently re-lift source coordinates carried in columns 4-6 using the authenticated UCSC hg19ToHg38.over.chain.gz and compare the resulting hg38 intervals against FILER-provided hg38 columns 1-3.
report: exact interval matches to FILER hg38 coordinates
match fraction with original denominator preserved
C3_COORDINATE_PROVENANCE_CONCORDANCE.interpretation: This is an outcome-blind harmonization audit. Coordinate discordance must be reported and cannot be hidden by overlap tolerances selected after inspection.
forbidden: retuning overlap windows to maximize agreement
dropping discordant rows without reporting them
using JEPA target identity, AD loci, Morabito or NIH-CARD biology to resolve coordinate disagreements

DATA_USE_AND_TERMS.requirement: For Table S5, FILER-hosted Nott ATAC tracks, and UCSC chain files, record source URL, access state, and explicit licence/terms if available.
DATA_USE_AND_TERMS.rule: Publicly downloadable does not by itself establish a licence. If explicit licence/terms are not verified, record terms as UNKNOWN rather than inferring permission.
DATA_USE_AND_TERMS.scientific_blocking: Terms uncertainty is not by itself a biological qualification failure, but provenance/usage status must be explicit before describing an artifact as openly reusable.

P1S_CLAIM_SCOPE_AMENDMENT.required_wording: Nott contact and accessibility layers share study context and PU.1-sorted material and may share donors. Their intersection supports internal microglial substrate compatibility, not independent external corroboration.
P1S_CLAIM_SCOPE_AMENDMENT.same_study_strength: Same-study neuron and oligodendrocyte comparators reduce cross-study assay/processing differences for specificity testing.
P1S_CLAIM_SCOPE_AMENDMENT.same_study_limitation: Because contact and ATAC layers are not guaranteed independent in donor/material/protocol provenance, P1S must not be presented as independent replication.
P1S_CLAIM_SCOPE_AMENDMENT.P1S_pass_supports: internal microglial substrate compatibility of the Nott-centered contact object relative to same-study cell-type comparators and the geometry-preserving null
P1S_pass_does_not_support: independent donor replication across contact and accessibility layers

EXECUTION_ORDER: run the already-frozen depth-sensitivity leakage diagnostic unchanged
run the already-frozen out-of-span TECH stress unchanged
execute C3 contact liftover/round-trip and ATAC source-coordinate re-liftover concordance audit
execute frozen P1S Nott same-study substrate fit
execute P3 non-trivial cell-type-negative eligibility filtering
instantiate E2_NOTT_CANDIDATE only if all required gates pass
